title: Proportional Controller Design for Elevator Position Control Using Root-Locus
expert_review: Well-structured problem illustrating how physical system properties reduce control complexity. Effectively combines modeling, root-locus analysis, and insight into natural disturbance rejection.
learning_objectives: Derive transfer function from mechanical equations of motion
Identify natural integrators in physical systems
Apply root-locus method to assess stability of P-controlled systems
Explain asymptotic tracking without explicit integral control
Recognize passive disturbance rejection through symmetric design
